prompt:
Hey, I just wrapped up our open house weekend at 47 Birchwood Lane and I have a pile of messy sign-in notes, text message exports, and a partial CRM dump sitting in my workspace folder. I need you to turn all of this into a ready-to-use action plan so I know exactly who to call first thing Monday morning and what to say to each person.

Please create a single file called `lead_followup_plan.md` that covers everything: who the hottest leads are, personalized texts and emails I can send each person, how to respond to the buyer who pushed back on interest rates, and a day-by-day schedule for the next week so nothing falls through the cracks. Also include compact notes I can paste directly into my CRM for each contact.

All the raw data is already in the workspace — the open house notes, the SMS thread, and the CRM CSV. Use all three sources.
